steps.caption: Guides
steps.narration: This is Guides. Playbooks, state licensing guides and setup walkthroughs, all on one page.

steps.caption: Search, or filter by topic
steps.narration: Search every guide and step, or filter by topic: ads, licensing, your website, Google Business and more.

steps.caption: Playbooks: Google Ads, LSA, Ad Fraud
steps.narration: The playbooks come first, like the twelve-section Google Ads guide and the LSA guide.

steps.caption: Free, or part of the Master Class
steps.narration: Each card's label says whether it's free, or part of the Master Class, and what your account has unlocked.

steps.caption: State licensing guides
steps.narration: The state licensing guides cover each state's formation, licensing, workers' comp and tax agencies.

steps.caption: Site connection guide
steps.narration: The site connection guide puts a site behind Cloudflare and connects Search Console, step by step.

steps.caption: Pick a topic
steps.narration: Pick a topic, like Google Business, to see its setup walkthroughs.

steps.caption: The buttons, in order
steps.narration: Each walkthrough names the buttons in order, and says what each one does and doesn't do.

steps.caption: Tick steps as you go
steps.narration: Tick each step as you go. Your progress is saved in this browser.

steps.caption: Open the page it describes
steps.narration: This button opens the page the walkthrough describes, so you can follow along.

steps.caption: Google Ads guide
steps.narration: The Google Ads guide is a playbook for contractor campaigns.

steps.caption: Twelve sections, in order
steps.narration: Start with campaign setup, and work through the twelve sections in order.

steps.caption: Home → Learn → Guides
steps.narration: You'll find Guides on the Home dashboard, in the Learn section.

youtube.description: A one-minute tour of Guides in ConstructHUB: the Google Ads and Local Services Ads playbooks, the state licensing guides, the site connection guide, and setup walkthroughs that name the buttons in order, with a checkbox per step.
